text: To all boats. Harbour Commander Totenhafen. The harbour is closed. I say again: the harbour is closed.
U-1047, report your position. U-1047, come in, please.
Convoy in grid square A-N four-zero-one-seven. Destroyer in sight. We are diving. Out.
Relayed from Basel, for U-1047: the cargo sails on the next tide. No queries.
This is U-1047, the chief engineer. The captain has gone down to the pump deck. He is not coming back up.
Weather for Totenhafen: wind north-west, force nine. Sea state seven. Spring tide in the night. Out.
